articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: Holly Taylor won the race for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 9 with 5,043,094 votes (52.3%); opponent: John Messinger (R) 4,602,681 (47.7%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
